thread:
alex: Quick readout — we're cutting over v2 endpoints for /chat and /embeds tonight at 00:30 PST. Drop any last-minute compatibility concerns here.
maria: Is the SDK patch (client-js #482) merged? Need it for the autodetect header and to avoid 403s on mobile.
li: It's merged to main but not cherry-picked to the release branch yet. I'll do the backport in ~15m.
sam: Can we confirm rollback triggers? Proposal: latency > 500ms sustained for 5m OR errors > 0.5% for 3m => pause and roll back. Thoughts?
jess: Ops playbook lives here: https://go/playbooks/v2-cutover — includes canary slice sizes and abort checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline kicked: pipeline/v2-cutover-runner build 129 — logs: https://ci/reports/129 (status: queued)
maria: Heads-up: mobile client uses a custom header name. If we don't accept fallback for x-rwd-version it will break. @li can we add a header fallback on the server side?
li: Adding fallback now. Patch:
```
// ensure backward compat
const version = req.headers['x-rwd-version'] || req.headers['x-client-version'] || 'v1';
req.headers['x-rwd-version'] = version;
```
Will include test.
alex: Nice. Any blockers from dependent teams? Are there services still hard-coded to v1?
sam: Ads-team flagged two services that haven't migrated. I pinged them; they requested a 24h grace window after canary completes.
jess: We can do a staggered ramp: canary 10% -> 25% -> 60% -> full, and keep ads lane out of the first 3 steps.
maria: I'll own metrics signoff — watching latency, error-rate, and model-compat regressions. Abort if errors > 0.5% or latency p95 jumps > 150ms baseline.
li: Cherry-pick done, running smoke tests in the release branch now. I'll post results in 10.
alex: Final ownership recap: SDK backport & header fallback (li), canary config & stagger plan (jess), metrics signoff (maria), rollback policy & infra pause (sam). I'll coordinate the timeline.
maria: Smoke tests passed on staging, sample payloads look compatible, telemetry hooks present. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary rollout 10% started at 1729004420 — monitoring enabled
sam: Alert hooks are wired into the runbook; if thresholds hit I will pause and notify.
alex: Great. If we don't see regressions in the first 30m of canary we'll proceed to 60% in +45m. Ping here when green or if anyone needs an immediate rollback. Thanks everyone!
